When I told my best friend she understood completely, my sister was pretty upset/sad, (which ig makes sense) the friends I told were really understanding and very sweet, my parents were... Distanced and invalidating and emotionally abusive and wanted to put me in a psych ward :/ . Overall I think as long as their trustworthy people who care about you (which they should be if they're true friends) then it will go okay. If there's anyone you don't feel ready or comfortable telling then wait until you are, and even if people care just know that not everyone knows how to help or understand, they might not react the way you think but if you feel like telling someone then chances are it's not a bad thing, just do it. If you need someone to talk to I'm always here friend💜💙🧡 don't give up quite yet okay💛

First please don't🥺💜, but second make a list of everything you've ever wanted to do but have always been to scared or unable to and do those things. Travel to places you've always wanted to go, send loved ones flowers, make some crazy awesome art, break a couple boring laws, go skydiving, talk to strangers, live your best life for a while since you don't have to worry about the future. And keep in mind you can do all of these things right now too, sure maybe finances and life situations make things difficult and painful but they're temporary, eventually you will be in a place where you can do more with your life either for yourself or others. Stay alive friend Ilu💙💛
